Officer's narrative
On arrival at the signalized intersection, I found a side-impact collision between two passenger vehicles. The front
driver's door of Driver 2's vehicle was pushed inward, and the rear quarter panel of Driver 1's vehicle showed
matching crush damage consistent with the reported angle of impact. Driver 1 reported pain in the right knee and was
transported for evaluation. Driver 1 presented a policy document listing Driver 1 as the named insured on the vehicle.
Passenger was seated in Driver 1's vehicle, and I observed Passenger at the scene. A bystander who had come out
of a nearby building also confirmed that Passenger had been ridnig in that vehicle. No independent witness reported
seeing the collision itself. No photographs were submitted by either party, and I located no other report of this
incident. A few older scratches are visible on Driver 1's bumper, and they may predate this crash. Both drivers were
cited for further review pending the investigation.
</page>
